reference.source: Length 83 ft 2 in (25.35 m), beam 20 ft 11 in (6.38 m), draft 5 ft (1.52 m), 300 hp and 10 kn from the published USS Crow (AMc-20) particulars, read 2026-10-11. NHHC photograph 80-G-277691 shows Crow in Puget Sound on 4 June 1943 during torpedo-recovery operations with torpedoes on the fantail; NHHC records her accidental sinking on 23 August 1943 while serving as a torpedo-plane target. deckHeightM, turnRateRadPerS and hullHp are gameplay/modeling choices. The merchant role intentionally makes this proposed training target unarmed.
